name: 002-peak-reset
prompt:
## Goal

Add a visible **Reset** control to the Peak windows card so a user can restore the default three-tier schedule after choosing a preset or customising hours.

## Context

`PeakScheduleSettings` offers preset buttons and custom hour toggles. Once the schedule changes, there is no one-click way to return to `DEFAULT_PEAK_SCHEDULE`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The Peak windows card has a `Reset` button with an accessible name.
- [ ] Clicking it calls `onChange(DEFAULT_PEAK_SCHEDULE)`.
- [ ] Disable the control when the current schedule already equals the default, or hide it; choose the simpler behavior and cover it with a test.
- [ ] Add a focused unit test in `src/components/__tests__/PeakScheduleSettings.test.tsx` for the reset action.
- [ ] No changes to plan data, calculation logic, workflows, or configuration.

## Verification

- `npm run lint:ci`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run test:coverage`
